rules.message: Content anchored to the head instead of the body or the world.
rules.fix: Body- or world-lock the panel. Keep head-locked content to brief notifications, and give the user a recenter gesture.

rules.message: Text or target sized in pixels rather than visual angle.
rules.fix: Size in angles: body text at least 1.2 degrees, gaze targets at least 2 degrees. Check on the device at 0.5, 1.5, and 3 metres.

rules.message: Glass and blur on several surfaces in one view.
rules.fix: Keep glass for chrome. Content surfaces stay opaque enough to read against passthrough.

rules.message: Panels placed at inconsistent depths or scales.
rules.fix: Use three depth planes (near 0.35-0.6 m, mid 1-2 m, far 3-10 m), one plane per task.

rules.message: Smooth continuous locomotion with no teleport alternative.
rules.fix: Make teleport plus snap turn the default. Keep smooth locomotion as an option with a vignette and a speed cap.

rules.message: Continuous movement without a comfort layer.
rules.fix: Add a vignette, a speed cap, snap turn, seated mode, and one-gesture recenter.

rules.message: Interaction only by ray; no direct touch or controller parity.
rules.fix: Support direct touch at arm's length, ray beyond it, and both hands and controllers for every action.
Offer recenter on one gesture, always available, and calibrate height on first run.

rules.message: Text drawn directly on passthrough, or on a panel too transparent to read.
rules.fix: Put text on an opaque plate or a panel at 90% opacity or more. Check contrast in a bright room.

rules.message: A two-dimensional web page floating in space.
rules.fix: Rebuild the content for spatial hierarchy: panels at one depth plane, direct manipulation, native spatial controls.

rules.message: Audio or video without captions or a text alternative.
rules.fix: Add captions, a transcript, or a text alternative for every audio-only moment.

rules.message: Interactive elements without hover, audio, or haptic feedback.
rules.fix: Every interaction gets a hover state, a commit cue, and a result state.

rules.message: Realistic hands or avatars that read as uncanny.
rules.fix: Use a stylized or abstract representation instead of an almost-real one.

rules.message: Bloom and emissive glow on every surface.
rules.fix: Use emissive only for state. If everything glows, the hierarchy is gone.
